title: Blow-up convergence + local finiteness ⇒ upper ball-mass bound μ(B_t(x)) ≤ c·t^n for c > θω_n
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on Euclidean N, x ∈ Euclidean N, T ∈ G(N,n) and θ, r₀ ∈ ℝ with θ > 0, r₀ > 0 and μ(closedBall x r₀) ≠ ∞. Assume that for every g ∈ C_c(Euclidean N, ℝ), t⁻¹^n ∫ g(t⁻¹ • (z − x)) dμ(z) → θ ∫_{T.plane} g dμHE[n] as t → 0⁺. Then for every c ∈ [0, ∞] with ENNReal.ofReal(θ) · unitBallVolume n < c, eventually as t → 0⁺ we have μ(closedBall x t) ≤ c · ENNReal.ofReal(t)^n.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ r₀ : ℝ), 0 < θ → 0 < r₀ → μ (closedBall x r₀) ≠ ⊤ → (∀ g : C_c(Euclidean N, ℝ), Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ t⁻¹ ^ n * ∫ z, g (t⁻¹ • (z - x)) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (θ * ∫ y in (T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)), g y ∂μHE[n]))) → ∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, ENNReal.ofReal θ * unitBallVolume n < c → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), μ (closedBall x t) ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ n
